svg.aria-label: Mortar architecture, staff workflows, hosting, AI, database and technology stack
svg.title: Mortar Architecture
svg.desc: Four staff personas handle messages from buyers, bankers and lawyers in Mortar’s web app. A Bun API shares domain rules with the browser, stores case history in Neon PostgreSQL, and calls Jev and Gemini on the server. GitHub Actions gates deployment to Render. The technology cards name every choice in the README stack.
